summary: Fixed network metrics to use nowrap=False for precise per-interface rates, preserving cumulative metrics with default nowrap. Discontinuous/wrap deltas are cleanly skipped and rebaselined without leaking stale caches on reconnect. A robust E2E test suite simulates psutil platform calls, proving exact float rate calculation, exact metric dimensions, edge-case resets, time wrap, disappeared interfaces, and full agent E2E spooling.
